metadata.description: Agent skill for the ktalk CLI — the Kontur.Talk API from the terminal

plugins.name: ktalk
plugins.description: Teaches the agent to read `ktalk --help` and `ktalk <group> <command> --help` before composing a command, and covers what the help cannot: env-var auth, cursor pagination, JSON output, transcript --format text, token scopes, and built-in 429 handling.
